nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned: internal reflection balances mutated during transfers and fee redistribution
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: ERC20 allowances written by _approve and consumed by transferFrom
address payable _feeAddrWallet: privileged fee recipient that receives contract ETH and can call manualswap/manualsend
mapping(address=>bool) bots: blacklist checked inside _transfer and modified by owner-only nonosquare/delBot
mapping(address=>uint) cooldown: per-address timestamp gate set during pair transfers
bool inSwap: reentrancy-ish lock toggled by lockTheSwap during swapTokensForEth
IUniswapV2Router02 uniswapV2Router: external router invoked for swaps and liquidity
transfer(address,uint256): public ERC20 entry point forwarding msg.sender into _transfer
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): public ERC20 entry point that moves tokens then decrements allowance
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core routing logic with fee selection, bot/cooldown checks and swap trigger
swapTokensForEth(uint256): approves and swaps tokens for ETH on the router under lockTheSwap
sendETHToFee(uint256): forwards ETH balance to _feeAddrWallet
openTrading(): owner-only setup creating the pair, adding liquidity and setting limits
manualswap(): fee-wallet-gated manual token swap of contract balance
manualsend(): fee-wallet-gated manual ETH send to fee wallet
nonosquare(address[]): owner-only loop adding addresses to the bots blacklist
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as transfer source and permission checks
block.timestamp: used for cooldown gating and as router deadline
external call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with user-derived tokenAmount
_feeAddrWallet.transfer(amount): value transfer to a privileged address (gas-limited send)
external calls createPair and addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance} during openTrading
from: sender address parameter of _transfer
to: recipient address parameter of _transfer
amount: transfer amount parameter of _transfer
contractTokenBalance: balanceOf(address(this)) captured before swapping to ETH
bots_: address array parameter of nonosquare used to populate the blacklist
uint256 _maxTxAmount: owner-adjustable transfer size limit enforced in _transfer
_tokenTransfer(address,address,uint256): private wrapper delegating to the standard transfer accounting
_transferStandard(address,address,uint256): recomputes reflections and mutates _rOwned balances
bool swapEnabled: flag enabling automatic swap-and-send inside _transfer
